The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zhorrid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] maintained an '''estate''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. Between the various tasks given to her by her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Darth Jadus]], Zhorrid returned to her estates on Sernpidal as well as the planets [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and [[Begeren]], where she indulged in a variety of luxuries and horrors until she was ordered elsewhere.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Zhorrid's estates were first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Sith Lord in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
